annotations.title: Find the ETFIQ page that answers a question

description: The designed ETFIQ pages that answer a question, best first, at most three: a fund, a comparison of two funds, the ETFs that hold a company, a ranking, a theme, a category, an issuer, the weekly flows report, a flows ranking, a dividend calendar, a screen, a benchmark, a model portfolio comparison, an FAQ answer or a methodology page. CALL THIS FIRST whenever the question could be answered by one ETFIQ page ("who holds NVDA", "SCHD vs VYM", "highest yielding covered call ETFs", "biggest ETF inflows this week"). Each page comes with its title, its address, its dated lead sentence exactly as the page prints it, and numbers from its own .json twin (a fund's key facts, or the dated answers in the page's FAQ), with the match score (0 to 100) and the reason. answered is false when no page reaches the threshold: then answer with the other tools. Matching is deterministic: an exact phrase, an exact pair or a named entity with the intent its page answers, then word overlap. Pass path instead of query to read one page's card by its address.

path.description: Optional, instead of query: one ETFIQ address, such as /holdings/nvda/, for that page's card.

query.description: The reader's question, in their words.

name: find_page
